verdict.rationale: Zapier exposes substantial programmatic surface. The Workflow API powers embedded automation. The SDK and SDK CLI execute actions across 9,000+ apps. A stored-actions endpoint exists. Zapier MCP lets AI clients take real actions. The integration CLI offers 'full control' as an alternative to the Visual Builder. However, nothing shows that UI-level work (building, editing and managing Zaps, Canvas, troubleshooting, server/team administration) can all be done via API, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. missing for 10: evidence of Zap creation/editing and account/admin management via API, documented UI-to-API parity, a published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.
